imports.modification_summary: Python to TypeScript, line for line in algorithm: atomic blocks (headers, code fences, table header plus separator, table rows, list items with continuations, paragraphs, blanks), greedy assembly with header-preferred splits that keep at least half a chunk, overlap lines and table-header carry across every continuation, start offset. Changes: offsets count UTF-16 code units; a code fence opens only on a CommonMark fence line (no backtick in its info string) and closes only on a line of at least as many backticks (the donor treats any line starting with three backticks as a fence boundary); header-preferred splits use running prefix sizes (the donor sums inside its backward scan, which is quadratic in a chunk's blocks). Names in Aladdin style.

imports.modification_summary: SPA state-blob removal (JSON in inline code, $type objects, nested objects, long lines that parse as JSON once the converter's escapes are undone). The donor's lazy regexes are replaced by linear scans with blobs bounded to 64 KiB; code-fence lines are kept verbatim; blank lines between blocks are kept (one at most) instead of all removed; trailing whitespace is trimmed by a scan, keeping Markdown hard breaks. Adds Aladdin's text safety rule: well formed (lone surrogates become U+FFFD), no controls, and no invisible characters that hide text or carry data (bidi controls, zero-width marks, fillers, variation selectors, tag characters).

imports.modification_summary: Keeps the donor's rules: non-content elements are skipped, hidden inline-JSON code (its id patterns) and inline data: images are dropped, a header row (thead, or a first row of th) leads the table. The donor serialises to HTML and converts with the Python markdownify package; Aladdin converts its own content model straight to Markdown (ATX headings, '-' bullets, GFM tables). No markdownify code is copied and no dependency is added. Unlike the donor, page text is escaped wherever a character could form syntax, so it cannot form links, images, HTML or block syntax (rules and setext headings included); characters that cannot form syntax in place are left readable. Links and images are opt-in, limited to resolved http(s) URLs without credentials and with destination-ending characters encoded, and taken only from shown elements; fences and code spans are longer than any backtick run inside; tables keep at most 64 columns and are walked iteratively; every emitted part is charged to the size and time bounds; nesting past 50 levels is flattened.

imports.modification_summary: The donor's CSS visibility rule (display none, visibility hidden, opacity 0) and its parsing of DOMSnapshot layout styles, applied to content and extended: only text with a layout object, visible computed visibility, a non-transparent colour and text fill (any colour syntax), a non-zero font size and a non-empty box not past the document's top or left edge is kept; subtrees with opacity or filter opacity below 0.01 and subtrees of boxes clipped to at most four pixels are dropped; attribute text is used only from rendered, visible elements; text the engine skipped under content-visibility auto is reported as truncated. The donor's viewport threshold is not used, its Runtime.evaluate calls (readyState, iframe scroll, getEventListeners) are not used, and live input values (inputValue, textValue) are never read.
